figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1. Scheme for early hydroxylation steps in taxoid biosynthesis. 5a-Hydroxy taxadiene, the product of the ﬁrst cytochrome P450-mediated
oxygenation step, can be either hydroxylated to 5a,13a-dihydroxy taxadiene or acetylated prior to hydroxylation at the C10b and C14b positions.
Subsequent hydroxylation steps in the formation of Taxol are undeﬁned.
